Overview.Name: Amulya Jeevanasai
Overview.Goal: Reduce cravings, improve mental wellbeing, and achieve steady fat loss.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + chicken curry (pressure cooked) + vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + egg curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Chicken curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Egg curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 3: Dal + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid soy products completely due to allergy.
Cravings improve when meals include enough protein and regular timing.
Avoid skipping meals even on busy days.
Keep spicy foods moderate to prevent overeating.
Simple, consistent meals work better than frequent changes.
As weight reduces, energy and mental clarity will improve gradually.
